name: Bà Sáu bán xôi
style_prompt: Same art style as the reference images: a plump middle-aged Vietnamese street vendor woman (Ba Sau), round kind face, dark hair in a low bun under a conical non la hat, faded dark-blue blouse, brown trousers, plastic sandals, carrying a bamboo basket of sticky rice wrapped in banana leaves. Hand-drawn crayon / colored-pencil texture, thick black outlines, simple chibi proportions, dot eyes, minimal flat colors, the same art style as the reference images. Never white clothing.
